entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 3879879704937353984: position at J2016.0. Distance: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 49637: distance 90.58 pc, the paper's parallax inverted (Gaia DR1's where it revised the star's, else the Hipparcos reduction of van Leeuwen 2007; section 2.3; fractional uncertainty 0.022), at which the luminosity and radius hold (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433): 90.58 +/- 1.993 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 11.0209 +/- 0.1661 mas (same row, RUWE 1.80), 66.4 standard errors, is not used. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): -82.021, -64.844 mas/yr. Radial velocity from SIMBAD's radial velocity for Gaia DR3 3879879704937353984 (quality A), from 2005A&A...430..165F; Gaia DR3 measures none.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 31.71 solar radii from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 49637: radius 31.71 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 260.547 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.064) and temperature (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433). No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 4121 +/- 125 K from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 49637: effective temperature 4121 +/- 125 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.079).
